answer: Randomized Assignment Lottery: each epoch, a verifiable random beacon assigns every identity a fresh shard of work and a peer set. An attacker cannot precompute which shards their clones will receive, so each clone must be provisioned with real capacity to handle any assignment — like stocking every hive with nectar before knowing the bloom. The trellis of assignments is public and checkable, exposing idle clones that fail their shard. Per-identity cost becomes full resource provisioning for all possible assignments, not a cheap registration. No fable of scarcity needed;
